blocking_issues.description: The original required exact sanity failed at 10crosswhite frame 1. Normalized values and resize factor matched, but singleton batch stride differed. The full exact native-policy sanity must pass after the pure crop view correction before formal evaluation. This is the existing runtime gate, not a request for additional defensive code.
blocking_issues.location: Original PureCADTracker.crop return and sanity assertion at frame 1

diagnosis: The controlled diagnostic holds templates and network fixed. Re-viewing the same own tensor with own[0].unsqueeze(0) changes only its singleton batch stride and restores bit-identical native score, size, offset, fused and modality outputs on this actual TRAIN input. This supports the stride mismatch as the cause of the observed search-forward discrepancy. It does not identify a specific CUDA kernel or certify the remaining trajectory.

minimal_fix.rationale: Single-image extraction and re-insertion of the batch dimension preserves values and restores the native singleton batch stride. The pure tracker uses this crop for search, initial template and template updates.

remaining_validation: Review the exact revised source and then run the existing two-TRAIN-prefix exact box/confidence/template/frame checks, including actual template updates, before any formal baseline. Retain the same exact equality requirements and retain R1 source/failure evidence.
limits: No SSH, GPU, NN execution or source edits by this reviewer.
The controlled evidence covers one actual first-frame search forward with common templates; it does not certify the revised initial-template/update trajectories, full sanity or dataset scores.
No evidence supports changing shared crop/model/config, the warm environment, backend flags or tolerances.
The original SOURCE_PASS remains a source-only historical review; the observed runtime failure is recorded separately and must not be relabeled as a pass.
